issue.title: Env audit + typed runtime validation
issue.body:
> **Scope note:** This ticket is **verification/validation only, NOT a rewrite**. The env migration (`@env`/`react-native-dotenv` removed → `EXPO_PUBLIC_*` via `process.env`, `apiBaseUrl.ts`, `env.d.ts`) was **already done on main**. Remaining scope: **confirm no residual `@env` references + optionally add typed runtime validation**. Assigned to @mattrace-gloo.

### Context

### Current state in baseline

- `src/config/apiBaseUrl.ts` reads `process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL` and throws if unset.
- `src/types/env.d.ts` declares `EXPO_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL: string` under `NodeJS.ProcessEnv`.
- `.env.example` = `EXPO_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL=http://10.0.2.2:9999`; `jest.env.cjs` defaults `http://localhost:9999`.
- Test CI (`.github/workflows/test.yml`) sets `EXPO_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL: http://localhost:9999`. No `FLUENT_USER_EMAIL` anywhere.
- `@env`/`react-native-dotenv` are **gone from main** (note: [PR #82](https://github.com/eten-tech-foundation/fluent-mobile/pull/82) still imports `@env` in `recordingSync.ts` — an anti-pattern, not merging).

### Problems / why

- Validation is single-key and ad-hoc (only the base URL, only at first use). New env (`EXPO_PUBLIC_OFFLINE_MODE` from #107) will need typing/validation too.
- No central typed config object; callers read `process.env` in scattered spots.
- Need a guard to prevent `@env` regressions creeping back (coordinate with lint #114).

### Target design

- A single typed config module (e.g. `src/config/env.ts`) that reads and validates all `EXPO_PUBLIC_*` values once and exports a typed object:

```ts
export const env = {
 apiBaseUrl: requireUrl('EXPO_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL'), // optional in offline mode
 offlineMode: boolEnv('EXPO_PUBLIC_OFFLINE_MODE'),
} as const;
```

- Keep `getApiBaseUrl()` (back it with the new module) so existing imports keep working; throw with the same actionable message.
- Extend `src/types/env.d.ts` with any new keys (`EXPO_PUBLIC_OFFLINE_MODE`).
- Document the env contract in onboarding docs (#112).

### Implementation steps

1. Grep the repo for any residual `@env` / `react-native-dotenv` references; remove if found (none expected on main).
2. Add `src/config/env.ts` with typed accessors + validation; re-implement `getApiBaseUrl()` on top of it.
3. Add `EXPO_PUBLIC_OFFLINE_MODE` (and any others) to `env.d.ts`.
4. Document env vars in docs; ensure `.env.example` is complete.
5. Coordinate a lint guardrail (#114) banning direct `process.env` reads outside `src/config/`.
6. Unit-test validation (missing/blank URL throws actionable error; offline flag parsing).

### Acceptance criteria (verify-only)

- [ ] **Confirm** no `@env`/`react-native-dotenv` references remain (migration already done on main).
- [ ] **Optional hardening:** a single typed config module validates all `EXPO_PUBLIC_*` keys; `getApiBaseUrl()` delegates to it.
- [ ] **Optional:** new keys typed in `env.d.ts`; `.env.example` complete.
- [ ] **Optional:** validation covered by unit tests.

### Test plan / verification

```bash
npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test -- --ci
```

- Tests default `EXPO_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL=http://localhost:9999` via `jest.env.cjs`; toggle env in-test to assert validation; **no live API required**.
- Do **not** use `FLUENT_USER_EMAIL`.

### Out of scope

- Offline-mode behavior (#107), lint rule implementation (#114), docs page authoring (#112).

### Links

- Epic: #120
- Related: #107 (offline flag), #114 (lint), #112 (docs)
- Anti-pattern: [PR #82](https://github.com/eten-tech-foundation/fluent-mobile/pull/82) `recordingSync.ts` `import { API_BASE_URL } from '@env'`
